title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pandian rescues a fainting Karthika, who confides in him about her marital woes. Meanwhile, Chandayatha ignores Cheran's warning and recalls Pallavan's mother's abandonment.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Ragavan Calls off the Movie Plan
description: The family's plans to go to the movies hit a snag when Ragavan is swayed by Thangaraj's words. His sudden decision to withdraw leaves Lakshmi feeling deeply disappointed.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 66: Power Shifts Twice in One Day
description: A new Junior BB takes charge. An emotional Vinoth demands answers, and flaws are exposed. Later, the courtroom task sparks a bitter Jason-Vinoth groupism fight.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Overcome by guilt, Aishwarya seeks forgiveness and punishment from Tamizhselvi. Meanwhile, Savithri refuses to reveal Aishwarya's deceit despite Eshwari's insistence.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja urges Aadhavan to reveal their love to the family without further delay. Elsewhere, Karikalan firmly rejects the traditional gifts, leaving Kasthuri's parents distressed.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu wins a bet for a pregnancy photoshoot with Kanmani after her expo success. As Vennila plots against her, Kanmani and Anbu bond, bringing hope of reconciliation.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Azhagappan pressures Kandhasamy into hosting a lavish reception for Shanmugam and Abhi at his own expense. Meanwhile, Murugan and Indhira gear up to launch their catering venture.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi confronts Pandian with past grievances and scolds the family for room decorations. As Meena teases the pair, Senthil fails her baby soothing test.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya and Ravi are furious, believing Shruthi has terminated her pregnancy. As Meena and Muthu struggle to cope, Annamalai urges Vijaya to respect Shruthi's personal choices.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Overcome by jealousy, Divya questions Prabhakaran after spotting him with a girl. Meanwhile, Sudar grows disappointed when Vetri does not return home for their outing.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar's farm injury triggers childhood memories of Meenatchi. Senthamizh stops wedding plans to meet Thennavan, while Mayandi urges Azhagar to take Thenmozhi's food.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Paraman fail to find Ayyappan at Rishi's house. Later, Ilamathi and Nalini trick Rishi with a fake food delivery call to uncover Ayyappan's exact whereabouts.
